title: Core: layer reorder, add, delete, rename
description: Implement layer management operations in packages/core/src/engine/layers.ts (new file). Functions: addLayer(doc, sceneIdx, afterLayerIdx?, type?), deleteLayer(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx), reorderLayer(doc, sceneIdx, fromIdx, toIdx), renameLayer(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, name), duplicateLayer(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx). All return new FlashDocument (immutable). Must handle edge cases: can't delete last layer, reorder bounds check. Add unit tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/layers.test.ts.
